│          selected_chunks = {}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          for question in questions:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              self.progress_callback(f"Optimizing query: {question}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              await self.agent.handle_intervention()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              human_content = f'Search Query: "{question}"'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              system_content = self.agent.parse_prompt(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                  "fw.document_query.optmimize_query.md"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              optimized_query = (                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                  await self.agent.call_utility_model(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                      system=system_content, message=human_content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              ).strip()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              await self.agent.handle_intervention()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              self.progress_callback(f"Searching documents with query: {optimized_query}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              normalized_uris = [self.store.normalize_uri(uri) for uri in document_uris]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              doc_filter = " or ".join(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                  [f"document_uri == '{uri}'" for uri in normalized_uris]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              chunks = await self.store.search_documents(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                  query=optimized_query,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                  limit=100,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                  threshold=DEFAULT_SEARCH_THRESHOLD,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  filter=doc_filter,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              self.progress_callback(f"Found {len(chunks)} chunks")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              for chunk in chunks:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  selected_chunks[chunk.metadata["id"]] = chunk                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          if not selected_chunks:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              self.progress_callback("No relevant content found in the documents")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              content = f"!!! No content found for documents: {json.dumps(document_uris)} matching queries: {json.dumps(questions)}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              return False, content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          self.progress_callback(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              f"Processing {len(questions)} questions in context of {len(selected_chunks)} chunks"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          await self.agent.handle_intervention()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          questions_str = "\n".join([f" *  {question}" for question in questions])                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          content = "\n\n----\n\n".join(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              [chunk.page_content for chunk in selected_chunks.values()]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          qa_system_message = self.agent.parse_prompt(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              "fw.document_query.system_prompt.md"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          qa_user_message = f"# Document:\n{content}\n\n# Queries:\n{questions_str}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          ai_response, _reasoning = await self.agent.call_chat_model(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              messages=[                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                  SystemMessage(content=qa_system_message),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                  HumanMessage(content=qa_user_message),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              ],                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              explicit_caching=False,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          self.progress_callback(f"Q&A process completed")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return True, str(ai_response)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      async def document_get_content(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          self, document_uri: str, add_to_db: bool = False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      ) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          self.progress_callback(f"Fetching document content")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          await self.agent.handle_intervention()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          url = urlparse(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          scheme = url.scheme or "file"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          mimetype, encoding = mimetypes.guess_type(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          mimetype = mimetype or "application/octet-stream"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          if mimetype == "application/octet-stream":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              if url.scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                  response: aiohttp.ClientResponse | None = None                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  retries = 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                  last_error = ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                  while not response and retries < 3:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                      try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                          async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                              response = await session.head(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                  document_uri,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                  timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=2.0),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                  allow_redirects=True,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                              if response.status > 399:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                  raise Exception(response.status)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                              break                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                      except Exception as e:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                          await asyncio.sleep(1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                          last_error = str(e)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                      retries += 1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                      await self.agent.handle_intervention()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  if not response:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                      raise ValueError(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │

│          if not contents:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│              import pdf2image                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              import pytesseract                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              PrintStyle.debug(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                  f"DocumentQueryHelper::handle_pdf_document: FALLBACK Converting PDF to images: {temp_file_path}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              pages = pdf2image.convert_from_path(temp_file_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              for page in pages:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  contents += pytesseract.image_to_string(page) + "\n\n"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return contents                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      finally:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          os.unlink(temp_file_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def handle_unstructured_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      # SSRF protection for file:// scheme: enforce restricted filesystem access                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      from urllib.parse import urlparse                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      import os                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      if scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          parsed = urlparse(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          actual_path = parsed.path.lstrip('/')                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          # Ensure path doesn't traverse outside allowed directory (e.g., current work directory)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          if ".." in actual_path or actual_path.startswith('/'):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              raise ValueError("Path traversal attempt detected")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          resolved = os.path.abspath(actual_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          # Optional: restrict to a known-safe directory (e.g., current work dir or upload directory)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          if not resolved.startswith(os.getcwd()):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              raise ValueError("Access outside allowed directory prohibited")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # For HTTP(S), apply same SSRF protections as above                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      if scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          from urllib.parse import urlparse                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          import ipaddress                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          import socket                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          parsed = urlparse(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          if not parsed.hostname:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              raise ValueError("Invalid URL: missing hostname")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              ip_info = socket.getaddrinfo(parsed.hostname, None, socket.AF_UNSPEC)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              ips = {addr[4][0] for addr in ip_info}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          except (socket.gaierror, OSError):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              raise ValueError(f"Invalid hostname: {parsed.hostname}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          for ip_str in ips:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  ip = ipaddress.ip_address(ip_str)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  if ip.is_private or ip.is_loopback or ip.is_link_local or ip.is_unspecified:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                      raise ValueError(f"SSRF prevented: blocked access to {ip_str}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              except ValueError:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  raise ValueError(f"SSRF prevented: unresolvable or invalid IP for {parsed.hostname}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Proceed with loader only after validation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      elements: list = []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      if scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          loader = UnstructuredLoader(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              web_url=document,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              mode="single",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              partition_via_api=False,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              strategy="hi_res",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          elements = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      elif scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          _, ext = os.path.splitext(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          import os                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=ext) as temp_file:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              temp_file.write(file_content_bytes)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              temp_file_path = temp_file.name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              loader = UnstructuredLoader(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  file_path=temp_file_path,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                  mode="single",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  partition_via_api=False,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  strategy="hi_res",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              elements = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          finally:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              os.unlink(temp_file_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      return "\n".join([element.page_content for element in elements])                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  2. Unsafe behavior removed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  - Directly issuing HTTP(S) requests to user-controlled URLs without validating target host/IP                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  - No禁用 redirects (`allow_redirects=True` by default in `requests.get`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  - No `file://` path validation, enabling local file traversal                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  - `AsyncHtmlLoader` usage without SSRF protections (replaced explicit validation + disallow redirects path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  3. Security control or validation added                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  - Resolver + IP address validation: resolves hostname and strictly rejects private/loopback/link-local/unspecified IPs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  - Disable redirects (`allow_redirects=False`) to prevent SSRF through redirects                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  - Enforce `file://` paths to current working directory only (no `..`, no absolute paths)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  - All URIs must be `http`/`https` with validated hostnames; invalid schemes rejected early                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  4. Why the patch removes the root cause                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  SSRF occurs when the application sends requests to attacker-specified destinations, including internal addresses. By validating resolved IPs against known dangerous ranges and disabling redirects, the patch ensures no request is made to internal endpoints or redirected through malicious intermediaries. For local files, the path             │
│  restriction prevents reading files outside intended scope (e.g., `/etc/passwd`). This eliminates both direct SSRF (via `requests.get`) and indirect SSRF via redirect chains or file URI abuse.                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│  class DocumentQueryStore:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      FAISS Store for document query results.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      Manages documents identified by URI for storage, retrieval, and searching.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Default chunking parameters                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE = 1000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      DEFAULT_CHUNK_OVERLAP = 100                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Cache for initialized stores                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      @staticmethod                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      def get(agent: Agent):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          """Create a DocumentQueryStore instance for the specified agent."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if not agent or not agent.config:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              raise ValueError("Agent and agent config must be provided")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Initialize store                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          store = DocumentQueryStore(agent)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
